questions.prompt: What kind of clothes do you like to wear?
questions.sampleA1: I like t-shirt. And jeans. I like blue.
questions.sampleA2: I like to wear casual clothes. I like jeans and t-shirts because they are comfortable. But sometimes I wear a dress when I go to a party.
questions.sampleB1: I usually wear comfortable clothes. I like jeans and t-shirts most of the time. In my opinion, they are easy to wear and practical. However, if I go to a special event, I will wear something nicer, like a dress or a suit. I think it's important to dress appropriately for different situations.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I'm all about comfort, so I tend to go for casual stuff most days — jeans, a hoodie, that kind of thing. I suppose I'm not really into high fashion, but I do like to dress up now and then for a special occasion. At the end of the day, I just want to feel comfortable in my own skin.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men futbolkani yaxshi ko'raman. Va jinsilar. Men ko'k rangni yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men kundalik kiyimlar kiyishni yoqtiraman. Menga jinsi shimlar va futbolkalar yoqadi, chunki ular qulay. Lekin ba'zida men ziyofatga borganimda ko'ylak kiyaman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Men odatda qulay kiyimlar kiyaman. Ko'pincha jinsi shimlar va futbolkalarni yaxshi ko'raman. Mening fikrimcha, ularni kiyish oson va ular amaliy. Biroq, agar men maxsus tadbirga borsam, ko'ylak yoki kostyum kabi yanada chiroyli narsa kiyaman. Menimcha, turli vaziyatlar uchun mos kiyinish muhim.
questions.uzSampleB2: Umuman olganda, men ham qulay, ham zamonaviy bo'lgan kiyimlarni afzal ko'raman. Kundalik kiyim uchun jinsi va chiroyli bluzka kabi oddiy kiyimlarga moyilman. Biroq, men ma'lum holatlar uchun chiroyli kiyinishni ham qadrlayman. Misol uchun, agar men rasmiy kechki ovqatga boradigan bo'lsam, men ko'ylak yoki zamonaviy shim kostyumini tanlashim mumkin. Oxir oqibat, menimcha, o'zingizni ishonchli va qulay his qiladigan kiyimlarni topish muhim.

questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to clothing, I genuinely have a preference for pieces that are both comfortable and stylish. I am someone who leans towards casual wear, as it allows me to feel at ease throughout my day. However, that being said, I also make an effort to keep up with the latest trends, because I honestly think that fashion is a form of expression.

"Clothes make the man." This saying holds a certain truth for me, as I believe that wearing the right outfit can boost one's confidence and make a lasting impression. For instance, when I'm attending a formal event, I tend to choose tailored suits that bring out a sense of elegance and professionalism. On the other hand, if I’m just hanging out with friends, you’ll most likely find me in a pair of jeans and a simple t-shirt.

Moreover, I truly appreciate sustainable fashion and often seek out brands that are environmentally conscious. I make it a point to support ethical brands whenever possible. Overall, my clothing choices are a blend of comfort, style, and responsibility, and I believe that's the perfect combination for me.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Kiyimga kelganda, men chin dildan ham qulay, ham zamonaviy bo'lgan narsalarni afzal ko'raman. Men kun davomida o'zimni erkin his qilishimga imkon beradigan kundalik kiyimlarga moyilman. Lekin shunga qaramay, men so'nggi tendensiyalardan xabardor bo'lishga harakat qilaman, chunki moda - bu o'zini ifoda etish shakli deb o'ylayman.

"Kiyim odamni yaratadi". Bu maqol men uchun ma'lum bir haqiqatni anglatadi, chunki to'g'ri kiyimni kiyish o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchni oshirishi va uzoq muddatli taassurot qoldirishi mumkin deb hisoblayman. Misol uchun, rasmiy tadbirga borganimda, men nafislik va professionallik hissini uyg'otadigan tikilgan kostyumlarni tanlashga harakat qilaman. Boshqa tomondan, agar men shunchaki do'stlarim bilan vaqt o'tkazayotgan bo'lsam, meni ko'pincha jinsi shim va oddiy futbolkada ko'rasiz.

Bundan tashqari, men barqaror modani juda qadrlayman va ko'pincha atrof-muhitga e'tiborli bo'lgan brendlarni qidiraman. Imkon qadar axloqiy brendlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashni maqsad qilaman. Umuman olganda, mening kiyim tanlovim qulaylik, uslub va mas'uliyatning aralashmasidir va menimcha, bu men uchun eng zo'r kombinatsiya.

The thing is, it only takes about fifteen minutes, so it's perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. Honestly, it turns out delicious every single time.

Men spaghetti bolonezni tayyorlay olaman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Absolutely, I can talk about a dish that I enjoy cooking: homemade lasagna. Lasagna is a classic Italian dish that I thoroughly enjoy making from scratch. To begin with, I prepare the pasta by making the dough and rolling it out into thin sheets. This step takes a bit of elbow grease, but the result is definitely worth it.

For the sauce, I use a hearty mixture of minced beef, tomatoes, and herbs, allowing it to simmer until the flavors are richly developed. Layering the pasta with the sauce, creamy béchamel, and a generous helping of mozzarella cheese is a labor of love. As it bakes in the oven, the aroma fills up the entire kitchen, making it hard to resist sneaking a taste!

Cooking this meal is not just about the food; it's about creating a memorable experience. I often invite friends over, and it's incredibly rewarding to see them tuck into the dish with gusto. Personally, I've found that cooking can be a great way to let your hair down and unwind after a long day. As the saying goes, "The way to a person's heart is through their stomach." That's certainly true in my case, as I believe that food brings people together and nourishes not just the body but also the soul.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Albatta, men o'zim tayyorlashni yoqtiradigan taom haqida gapira olaman: uyda tayyorlangan lazanya. Lazanya - bu klassik italyan taomi, uni men noldan tayyorlashdan juda zavqlanaman. Avvalo, men xamir qilib, uni yupqa qatlamlarga yoyib, pasta tayyorlayman. Bu bosqich biroz kuch talab qiladi, lekin natija bunga arziydi.

Sous uchun men qiyma go'sht, pomidor va o'tlarning to'yimli aralashmasidan foydalanaman va ta'mlar boyib ketguncha qaynataman. Pastani sous, qaymoqli bechamel va mo'l-ko'l motsarella pishlog'i bilan qatlamlash - bu sevgi bilan qilingan mehnat. U pechda pishirilganda, xushbo'y hid butun oshxonani to'ldiradi, bu esa bir tatib ko'rishga qarshilik qilishni qiyinlashtiradi!

Bu taomni tayyorlash faqatgina ovqat haqida emas; bu unutilmas tajriba yaratish demakdir. Men ko'pincha do'stlarimni taklif qilaman va ularning ishtaha bilan taomga yopishib olishlarini ko'rish juda yoqimli. Shaxsan men, ovqat pishirish uzoq kundan keyin dam olish va hordiq chiqarishning ajoyib usuli bo'lishi mumkinligini aniqladim. Aytishlaricha, "Odamning qalbiga yo'l uning oshqozonidan o'tadi." Bu mening holatimda ham to'g'ri, chunki men ovqat odamlarni birlashtiradi va nafaqat tanani, balki ruhni ham oziqlantiradi, deb hisoblayman.

questions.prompt: Tell me about a TV show you enjoy.
questions.sampleA1: I like TV. I like cartoons. I like Tom and Jerry. It is funny.
questions.sampleA2: I like the TV show Friends. It is about friends in New York. They are funny and I like to watch them. It is good because it makes me happy. I watch it with my family.
questions.sampleB1: I enjoy watching The Great British Baking Show. It's a competition where people bake cakes and bread. I think it's interesting because I like to see what they create. Also, the judges are nice, but they give good criticism. Sometimes it makes me want to bake, but I'm not very good at it. However, it's a relaxing show to watch after a long day.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I'm a big fan of Breaking Bad — it's probably one of the best series I've watched. It follows a chemistry teacher who ends up in the drug world, and the storyline just keeps you on the edge of your seat. I suppose what I love most is how the characters are so well written. I could easily binge-watch it all weekend.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men televizorni yaxshi ko'raman. Men multfilmlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Men Tom va Jerrini yaxshi ko'raman. U kulguli.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga "Do'stlar" seriali yoqadi. U Nyu-Yorkdagi do'stlar haqida. Ular kulguli va men ularni tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'raman. U yaxshi, chunki u meni xursand qiladi. Men uni oilam bilan tomosha qilaman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Men "The Great British Baking Show" ko'rishni yoqtiraman. Bu odamlar tortlar va nonlar pishiradigan musobaqa. Menimcha, bu qiziqarli, chunki ularning nima yaratayotganini ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman. Bundan tashqari, hakamlar yaxshi, lekin ular yaxshi tanqid berishadi. Ba'zida bu meni pishirishni xohlaydi, lekin men unchalik yaxshi emasman. Biroq, bu uzoq kundan keyin tomosha qilish uchun dam beruvchi ko'rsatuv.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men ayniqsa qiziqarli deb topadigan bir teleshou bu "Qora Oyna"dir. Bu texnologiyaning potentsial distopik oqibatlarini o'rganadigan antologiya serialidir. Menga eng yoqadigan narsa uning fikr-mulohazaga undovchi tabiatidir; har bir epizod texnologik taraqqiyotning axloqiy oqibatlarini ko'rib chiqishga majbur qiladigan noyob stsenariyni taqdim etadi. Shou oson javoblarni taklif qilmaydi va ko'pincha titrlar tugaganidan keyin ham murakkab savollar ustida o'ylashga majbur qiladi. Ba'zi epizodlar, albatta, bezovta qiluvchi bo'lsa-da, ular jamiyat qanday yo'nalishda ketishi mumkinligi haqida ogohlantiruvchi hikoya bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Bu siz bilan qoladigan, munozaralarga undaydigan va hayotimizda texnologiyaning roli haqidagi o'z nuqtai nazaringizni shubha ostiga qo'yadigan shou.

questions.sampleAnswer: One TV show that I absolutely adore is Stranger Things. This show, set in the 1980s, revolves around a group of young friends who stumble upon a series of supernatural events. What truly captivates me is the intricate plot and the engaging character development. The creators have brought to life a nostalgic world that perfectly blends fantasy with reality. "The devil is in the details," and this show masterfully incorporates subtle 80s references that make it exceptionally appealing. I particularly enjoy how the show keeps you on the edge of your seat with its unexpected twists. Watching it has become a weekly ritual for me, allowing me to let my hair down and escape reality for a while. "Old is gold," and this series brings back the charm of retro storytelling with a modern twist. I highly recommend Stranger Things to anyone who enjoys a mix of mystery, adventure, and a dash of nostalgia.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Men mutlaqo sevib tomosha qiladigan bir teleserial bu Stranger Things. 1980-yillarda bo'lib o'tadigan bu serial, bir qator g'ayritabiiy hodisalarga duch kelgan yosh do'stlar guruhi haqida hikoya qiladi. Meni chinakamiga o'ziga rom etadigan narsa bu murakkab syujet va qiziqarli personajlarning rivojlanishidir. Yaratuvchilar fantaziyani haqiqat bilan mukammal uyg'unlashtirgan nostaljik dunyoni jonlantirishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi. "Iblis tafsilotlarda yashiringan", va bu serial 80-yillarga oid nozik ishoralarni mohirlik bilan o'z ichiga oladi, bu uni juda jozibali qiladi. Ayniqsa, serialning kutilmagan burilishlari bilan sizni doimo hayajonda ushlab turishini yoqtiraman. Uni tomosha qilish men uchun har haftalik odatga aylandi, bu menga bir muddatga dam olish va voqelikdan qochish imkonini beradi. "Eski oltin", va bu serial retro hikoyalarning jozibasini zamonaviy tus bilan qaytaradi. Stranger Thingsni sir, sarguzasht va bir ozgina nostalji aralashmasini yoqtiradigan har bir kishiga tavsiya qilaman.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1: I see woman. She walks. Mountain. And city. Many buildings.
questions.sampleA2: I see a woman in the mountains. She is walking. And I see a city. It is big and has many buildings. I like the mountains but the city is okay too.
questions.sampleB1: In the first picture, I see a woman hiking in the mountains. It looks very peaceful and she seems to be enjoying the nature. In the second picture, I see a big city. There are lots of tall buildings and it looks very busy. I think both places are interesting, but I prefer the mountains because it's quieter.
questions.sampleB2: So in the first picture, I can see a woman out hiking along a trail, with a big backpack and a cap, surrounded by lush green forest and misty mountains in the background. It looks incredibly peaceful. The second one, on the other hand, shows a busy street crossing in what looks like a city — probably Singapore — with loads of people making their way across the road. To be honest, the two couldn't be more different: one is calm and natural, while the other is crowded and fast-paced. Personally, I'd much rather be out on that mountain trail.

questions.uzSampleB1:
Birinchi rasmda men tog'larda sayr qilayotgan ayolni ko'ryapman. U juda tinch ko'rinadi va u tabiatdan zavqlanayotganga o'xshaydi.
Ikkinchi rasmda men katta shaharni ko'ryapman. U yerda ko'plab baland binolar bor va u juda band ko'rinadi. Menimcha, ikkala joy ham qiziqarli, lekin men tog'larni afzal ko'raman, chunki u yerda tinchroq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Birinchi rasmda go'zal tog' tizmasiga o'xshagan joyda sayr qilayotgan ayolni ko'rish mumkin. U ochiq havoda vaqt o'tkazayotganga o'xshaydi, ehtimol, yolg'izlik va toza havo izlayotgandir. Ikkinchi rasm birinchisidan keskin farq qiladi, unda gavjum shahar manzarasi, ehtimol, yirik metropoliten hududi tasvirlangan. Rasmda baland binolar hukmronlik qiladi va tez sur'atli, dinamik muhitni ko'rsatadi. Ikkala manzara ham o'ziga xos jozibaga ega bo'lsa-da, men birinchi rasmdagi tabiiy landshaft taklif qilayotgan xotirjamlikka ko'proq intilaman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the first image, I observe a solitary woman engaged in hiking along a picturesque mountain trail. The natural beauty of the landscape is perfectly encapsulated in the scene, with the rugged terrain and lush greenery offering a sense of serenity and freedom. This picture brings to mind the idiom "a breath of fresh air", as the woman appears to be soaking up the tranquility and getting away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Personally, I often relish similar outdoor activities, as they provide a great opportunity to let my hair down and reconnect with nature.

In contrast, the second image depicts a bustling urban scene, likely in a city such as Singapore, which is renowned for its modern infrastructure and dynamic environment. The vibrant cityscape, with its towering skyscrapers and efficient public transport, truly exemplifies the phrase "the city that never sleeps". This image highlights the fast-paced lifestyle that is characteristic of urban areas, where people carry on with their daily activities amidst a sea of diversity and opportunity. It's incredibly fascinating how cities like this become melting pots of culture, innovation, and economic growth.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi suratda men tog' yo'lagi bo'ylab sayr qilayotgan yolg'iz ayolni ko'rmoqdaman. Manzaraning tabiiy go'zalligi sahnada mukammal aks etgan, qo'pol relyef va serhosil ko'katlar xotirjamlik va erkinlik hissini taqdim etadi. Bu surat "toza havo" iborasini eslatadi, chunki ayol xotirjamlikdan bahramand bo'lib, kundalik hayotning shovqinidan uzoqlashayotganga o'xshaydi. Shaxsan men o'xshash ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlardan ko'pincha zavqlanaman, chunki ular dam olish va tabiat bilan qayta bog'lanish uchun ajoyib imkoniyatni beradi.

Farqli o'laroq, ikkinchi suratda gavjum shahar manzarasi tasvirlangan, ehtimol Singapur kabi shahar, u zamonaviy infratuzilmasi va dinamik muhiti bilan mashhur. Baland osmono'par binolar va samarali jamoat transporti bilan gavjum shahar manzarasi "hech qachon uxlamaydigan shahar" iborasining haqiqiy namunasidir. Bu surat shahar hududlariga xos bo'lgan tez sur'atli turmush tarzini ta'kidlaydi, bu yerda odamlar xilma-xillik va imkoniyatlar dengizi o'rtasida kundalik ishlarini davom ettiradilar. Bunday shaharlar madaniyat, innovatsiya va iqtisodiy o'sish qozoniga aylanishi juda hayratlanarli.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What are the benefits of spending time in nature?...
idioms: "Nature calls to the soul and calms the mind" - "Tabiat ruhni chaqiradi va ongni tinchlantiradi"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I believe that spending time in nature offers an unparalleled sense of tranquility and rejuvenation." - "Rostini aytsam, tabiatda vaqt o'tkazish mislsiz osoyishtalik va yangilanish hissini taqdim etadi deb o'ylayman."

"From my perspective, immersing oneself in the natural world can significantly enhance mental well-being." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, tabiat dunyosiga sho'ng'ish ruhiy farovonlikni sezilarli darajada yaxshilashi mumkin."
"I'd have to say that nature serves as an inexhaustible source of inspiration and creativity." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, tabiat tuganmas ilhom va ijod manbai sifatida xizmat qiladi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Spending time in nature truly offers a plethora of benefits, both physically and mentally. "Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished." This quote perfectly encapsulates the healing pace of the natural world, which can bring about a sense of calm and relaxation that is hard to find in the hustle and bustle of modern life.

Physically, engaging with nature often involves activities such as hiking or cycling, which are excellent forms of exercise. These activities not only enhance cardiovascular health but also allow individuals to soak up vitamin D, which is crucial for bone health. Furthermore, being in green spaces has been shown to lower blood pressure and reduce stress levels.

On a mental level, nature undoubtedly provides a space for reflection and can help out in recharging one's batteries. It's been scientifically proven that spending time in natural settings can improve mood, increase feelings of happiness, and boost creativity. For me, personally, a walk in the forest often helps to clear my mind and see the silver lining in challenging situations.

Moreover, in this digital age, where we're bombarded with information, stepping into nature allows us to unplug and unwind. It genuinely serves as a reminder that life is about more than screens and notifications. "Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better." This insight by Albert Einstein notably suggests that nature can offer profound understanding and clarity. So, whether it's a leisurely stroll in the park or a camping trip in the mountains, the benefits of spending time in nature are immensely rewarding.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Tabiatda vaqt o'tkazish, haqiqatan ham, jismoniy va ruhiy jihatdan ko'plab foydalarni taqdim etadi. "Tabiat shoshilmaydi, lekin hamma narsaga erishiladi." Ushbu iqtibos tabiat olamining shifobaxsh sur'atini mukammal ifodalaydi, bu esa zamonaviy hayotning shovqin-suronida topish qiyin bo'lgan xotirjamlik va dam olish hissini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

Jismoniy jihatdan, tabiat bilan aloqa qilish ko'pincha piyoda yurish yoki velosipedda sayr qilish kabi mashg'ulotlarni o'z ichiga oladi, ular ajoyib mashq turlari hisoblanadi. Ushbu mashg'ulotlar nafaqat yurak-qon tomir salomatligini yaxshilaydi, balki odamlarga suyak salomatligi uchun juda muhim bo'lgan D vitaminini olish imkoniyatini ham beradi. Bundan tashqari, yashil hududlarda bo'lish qon bosimini pasaytirishi va stress darajasini kamaytirishi isbotlangan.

Ruhiy darajada, tabiat, shubhasiz, fikrlash uchun joy beradi va kuchni tiklashga yordam berishi mumkin. Tabiiy muhitda vaqt o'tkazish kayfiyatni yaxshilashi, baxt tuyg'ularini oshirishi va ijodkorlikni rag'batlantirishi ilmiy jihatdan isbotlangan. Men uchun, shaxsan, o'rmonda sayr qilish ko'pincha ongimni tozalashga va qiyin vaziyatlarda umid uchqunini ko'rishga yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, biz axborot bilan to'lib toshgan ushbu raqamli asrda, tabiatga qadam qo'yish bizga dam olish va tarmoqdan uzilish imkoniyatini beradi. Bu, chinakamiga, hayot ekranlar va bildirishnomalardan ko'ra ko'proq narsadan iborat ekanligini eslatib turadi. "Tabiatga chuqur nazar soling, shunda hamma narsani yaxshiroq tushunasiz." Albert Eynshteynning ushbu fikri tabiat chuqur tushuncha va aniqlikni taklif qilishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydi. Shunday ekan, bu bog'da bemalol sayr qilishmi yoki tog'larda lagerda dam olishmi, tabiatda vaqt o'tkazishning foydalari juda katta.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer living in a big city instead of the countryside?
questions.sampleA1: I like city. It is fun. Country is boring.
questions.sampleA2: I like the city. There are many shops and restaurants. And there are many people. The countryside is quiet, but I don't like quiet.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people prefer living in a big city because there are more things to do. For example, there are more shops and cinemas. Also, it's easier to find a job in a city. However, the countryside is more peaceful.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I suppose the main reason is convenience. In a big city, everything is on your doorstep — shops, restaurants, public transport, you name it. On top of that, there tend to be more job opportunities, which is a huge draw for young people. To be honest, some folks thrive on the buzz and never get bored, whereas the countryside can feel too quiet.

Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar katta shaharda yashashni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki u yerda qilinadigan ishlar ko'proq.
Masalan, do'konlar va kinoteatrlar ko'proq. Shuningdek, shaharda ish topish osonroq.
Biroq, qishloq tinchroq.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Nima uchun ba'zi odamlar qishloqning osoyishtaligidan ko'ra gavjum shaharda yashashni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor.
Avvalo, shaharlar ko'proq ish imkoniyatlari va martaba istiqbollarini taklif qilishga moyil.
Bundan tashqari, xilma-xil madaniy muhit va konsertlar va ko'rgazmalar kabi ko'plab ko'ngilochar variantlar ko'pchilik uchun muhim omil hisoblanadi. Qishloq tabiiy go'zallik va sekinroq hayot tarziga ega bo'lsa-da, shahar ba'zi odamlarga ko'proq yoqadigan dinamik va rag'batlantiruvchi muhitni ta'minlaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Why do some people prefer living in a big city ins...
idioms: "The city never sleeps" - "Shahar hech qachon uxlamaydi"
bright lights, big city - "yorqin chiroqlar, katta shahar"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I believe that the allure of urban life is irresistible for many." - "Rostini aytsam, menimcha, shahar hayotining jozibasi ko'plar uchun qarshilik ko'rsatib bo'lmaydigan darajada."
"From my perspective, the dynamic and vibrant atmosphere of a big city is a major draw." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, katta shaharlarning dinamik va jonli muhiti katta jalb qiladi."

"I'd have to say that the plethora of opportunities available in urban areas is a significant factor." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, shahar hududlarida mavjud bo'lgan ko'plab imkoniyatlar muhim omil hisoblanadi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Living in a big city has its allure and appeal for many individuals, and there are several compelling reasons why some people genuinely prefer it over residing in the countryside. Firstly, urban areas offer up a plethora of opportunities in terms of career advancement and professional growth. The world is your oyster when it comes to the variety of job prospects available, as companies and industries are densely concentrated in metropolitan areas.

Moreover, the social experience in a big city can be incredibly enriching. Cities are often melting pots of cultures, and this diversity gives rise to a vibrant social life with numerous events, festivals, and opportunities to meet up with people from various backgrounds. Personally, I find this aspect particularly enticing as it broadens one's horizon and opens up new perspectives.

Another significant draw is the convenience factor. Cities really excel in terms of infrastructure, with high-street stores, restaurants, and recreational facilities at one's doorstep. Public transport systems are often extremely efficient, making it easier to get around without the necessity of owning a car. As the saying goes, "time is money", and the ability to save time on commuting and access amenities with ease is a huge advantage.

In contrast, while the countryside offers tranquility and natural beauty, some people may find the slower pace of life and limited amenities less appealing. As someone who thrives on activity and variety, I honestly believe that the dynamic nature of city life provides a sense of excitement and fulfillment that the countryside might not offer. To each his own, but for those who prioritize convenience, opportunity, and a bustling social scene, the city is undoubtedly the preferred choice.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Katta shaharda yashash ko'plab odamlar uchun o'ziga xos joziba va qiziqishga ega, va ba'zi odamlar qishloqda yashashdan ko'ra shuni afzal ko'rishining bir nechta asosli sabablari bor. Birinchidan, shahar hududlari martaba o'sishi va professional rivojlanish nuqtai nazaridan ko'plab imkoniyatlarni taqdim etadi. Ish istiqbollarining xilma-xilligi nuqtai nazaridan imkoniyatlar juda keng, chunki kompaniyalar va sanoatlar metropoliten hududlarida zich joylashgan.

Bundan tashqari, katta shahardagi ijtimoiy tajriba nihoyatda boyituvchi bo'lishi mumkin. Shaharlar ko'pincha madaniyatlar qozonidir va bu xilma-xillik turli xil tadbirlar, festivallar va turli xil kelib chiqishi bo'lgan odamlar bilan uchrashish imkoniyatlari bilan jonli ijtimoiy hayotga olib keladi. Shaxsan men bu jihatni ayniqsa jozibali deb bilaman, chunki u insonning ufqini kengaytiradi va yangi istiqbollarni ochadi.

Yana bir muhim omil - qulaylik omili. Shaharlar infratuzilma nuqtai nazaridan juda yaxshi, ko'cha do'konlari, restoranlar va dam olish maskanlari bir qadam narida joylashgan. Jamoat transporti tizimlari ko'pincha juda samarali bo'lib, mashinaga ega bo'lish zaruratisiz harakatlanishni osonlashtiradi. Aytganlaridek, "vaqt - pul", va qatnovga vaqtni tejash va qulayliklarga oson kirish imkoniyati katta afzallikdir.

Aksincha, qishloq tinchlik va tabiiy go'zallikni taqdim etsa-da, ba'zi odamlar hayotning sekin sur'ati va cheklangan qulayliklarni kamroq jozibali deb topishlari mumkin. Faollik va xilma-xillikni qadrlaydigan odam sifatida, men shahar hayotining dinamik tabiati qishloq taklif qila olmaydigan hayajon va qoniqish hissini beradi deb ishonaman. Har kimning o'z didi bor, lekin qulaylik, imkoniyat va gavjum ijtimoiy hayotni ustuvor deb biladiganlar uchun shahar, shubhasiz, afzal ko'riladigan tanlovdir.

Also, I like to learn about new topics, like science or history.

questions.sampleB2: To be honest, curiosity is something I've always valued, and I genuinely think it's one of the most important traits a person can have. If I think back, one time my curiosity really paid off was when I stumbled across an article about coding. I had no clue what it was about, but I got so intrigued that I ended up signing up for an online course. Before I knew it, I could build simple websites, and that little spark of curiosity opened a door I never expected. On a personal level, I'd say being curious has helped me come out of my shell and meet all sorts of people. Whenever I travel, I'm always asking questions and trying to soak up the local culture, which has broadened my horizons massively. Professionally, the thing is, curiosity keeps you on your toes — you're constantly learning new skills instead of standing still, and honestly, employers tend to value that kind of drive. As for society as a whole, I suppose curiosity is basically the engine behind all progress. Think about it — every major invention, from the light bulb to the internet, started with someone asking, 'What if?' Scientists and entrepreneurs who push the boundaries and refuse to take things at face value are the ones who drive innovation forward. At the end of the day, without that hunger to explore and question everything, I reckon we'd still be stuck in the past. So yeah, I firmly believe curiosity is what moves the world.

bulletPoints: Share a time when your curiosity led you to discover or learn something valuable.
How has curiosity influenced your personal or professional growth?
In what ways does curiosity drive innovation and progress in society?
questions.sampleAnswer:
Reflecting on my personal journey, there was a time when my genuine curiosity led me to discover something truly valuable. I stumbled upon a documentary about renewable energy, which completely fascinated me. This curiosity drove me to dive deeper into the subject, and I eventually signed up for a course in sustainable engineering. The knowledge I gained from this experience was not only eye-opening but also paved the way for my current career in the renewable energy sector.

Curiosity has been a catalyst for growth in my professional journey. By constantly asking questions and seeking new challenges, I've developed a broad skill set that allows me to adapt to changing environments. This mindset has paid off, as I've been able to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving industry. Moreover, by embracing curiosity, I've learned to "think outside the box", which has remarkably enhanced my problem-solving abilities.

When it comes to societal progress, curiosity serves as the bedrock of innovation. It is through a burning desire to understand the unknown that breakthroughs are made. Take, for example, the rise of technology giants; their advancements were fueled by a relentless quest for improvement. Curiosity drives us to question the status quo, push boundaries, and in doing so, "necessity is the mother of invention." In essence, it is the driving force behind every major leap in human civilization.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shaxsiy tajribamga nazar tashlasam, bir paytlar mening chinakam qiziquvchanligim meni haqiqatan ham qimmatli narsani kashf etishga olib kelgan edi. Men qayta tiklanadigan energiya haqidagi hujjatli filmga duch keldim, bu meni butunlay hayratga soldi. Bu qiziquvchanlik meni mavzuni chuqurroq o'rganishga undadi va oxir-oqibatda barqaror muhandislik kursiga yozildim. Bu tajribadan olgan bilimlarim nafaqat ko'zni ochuvchi bo'ldi, balki qayta tiklanadigan energiya sohasidagi hozirgi kareramga yo'l ochdi.

Qiziquvchanlik mening professional yo'limda o'sish katalizatori bo'ldi. Doimiy ravishda savollar berish va yangi qiyinchiliklarni izlash orqali men o'zgaruvchan muhitlarga moslashishga imkon beradigan keng ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirdim. Bu fikrlash tarzining foydasi tegdi, chunki men tez rivojlanayotgan sohada oldinda qolishga muvaffaq bo'ldim. Bundan tashqari, qiziquvchanlikni qabul qilib, men "standartdan tashqari fikrlashni" o'rgandim, bu mening muammolarni hal qilish qobiliyatimni sezilarli darajada oshirdi.

Jamiyat taraqqiyotiga kelsak, qiziquvchanlik innovatsiyaning asosi bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Aynan noma'lumni tushunishga bo'lgan kuchli istak orqali yutuqlarga erishiladi. Misol uchun, texnologiya gigantlarining yuksalishini olaylik; ularning yutuqlari takomillashtirishga bo'lgan tinimsiz intilish bilan ta'minlangan. Qiziquvchanlik bizni mavjud holatni shubha ostiga qo'yishga, chegaralarni kengaytirishga undaydi va shunday qilib, "ehtiyoj ixtironing onasidir". Aslida, bu insoniyat tsivilizatsiyasidagi har bir yirik sakrashning harakatlantiruvchi kuchidir.

questions.prompt: University Degrees Are No Longer Necessary for a Successful Career
questions.sampleA1: I think no. I have no degree. I work.
questions.sampleA2: I think university is good, but maybe not for everyone. My brother went to university and he has a good job. But my friend didn't go and he is also happy and has a job. So, it depends, I think.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think university degrees can be helpful for a career. However, I don't think they are always necessary. For example, some people learn skills online or through work experience. In my opinion, it depends on the job. Some jobs need a degree, but others don't. It's also about what you want to do.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really interesting topic, and to be honest, I can see both sides of the argument. On the one hand, there's a strong case that a degree isn't essential anymore. Loads of successful entrepreneurs — think of people like Steve Jobs — never actually finished university, yet they still made it big. On top of that, with all the online courses out there, you can pretty much teach yourself almost any skill from the comfort of your own home. In some industries, especially tech, employers care far more about what you can actually do than about a piece of paper. On the other hand, I don't think we should throw the baby out with the bathwater. For a lot of professions — like medicine or law — a formal degree is absolutely non-negotiable; you simply can't practise medicine without one. What's more, statistics show that graduates tend to earn more and enjoy better job security in the long run. University also gives you the chance to build up a network of contacts, which can open doors later in your career. So where do I stand? Personally, I'd say it really depends on the field. The thing is, a degree still carries a lot of weight, but it's no longer the be-all and end-all. At the end of the day, what matters most is a healthy mix of solid skills, real experience, and a genuine willingness to keep on learning. That, I reckon, is the real key to building a successful career.

questions.uzSampleB2: Universitet diplomlari karyera muvaffaqiyati uchun hali ham zarurmi degan savol juda qiziq. Diplom, shubhasiz, eshiklarni ochishi va bilimning mustahkam asosini ta'minlashi mumkin bo'lsa-da, menimcha, bu endi muvaffaqiyatli karyeraga olib boradigan yagona yo'l emas. Onlayn ta'lim platformalari va muqobil o'quv dasturlarining rivojlanishi an'anaviy diplomga ega bo'lmasdan turib, ma'lum kasblar uchun zarur bo'lgan ko'nikmalarni egallashni har qachongidan ham osonlashtirdi. Bundan tashqari, amaliy tajriba va kuchli portfel ko'pincha akademik malakalardan kam bo'lmagan, balki undan ham qimmatliroq bo'lishi mumkin. Oxir-oqibat, menimcha, bu shaxsning maqsadlariga va ularning qiziqish doirasidagi aniq sohaga bog'liq.

for: Many successful entrepreneurs never completed university.
Online courses and self-learning provide alternatives.
Some industries prioritize skills over formal qualifications.
against: A degree often increases job opportunities and pay.

questions.sampleAnswer:
"Success is not the key to happiness. Happiness is the key to success." This often resonates when discussing the necessity of university degrees for a successful career. On one hand, many successful entrepreneurs like Steve Jobs and Mark Zuckerberg have demonstrated that academic qualifications are not imperative for climbing the ladder of success. The rise of online courses and platforms such as Coursera and Udemy has opened up a myriad of opportunities for self-directed learning. In some industries, especially within tech, skills and innovation take precedence over formal qualifications, allowing individuals to step into roles traditionally reserved for degree holders.

On the flip side, it is undeniably true that possessing a degree can significantly widen the scope of job opportunities available, often leading to higher salaries. There are professions, such as medicine and law, where formal education is an absolute necessity, ensuring the standards are met and upheld. Furthermore, the university experience provides invaluable networking opportunities that can be pivotal in one's career path. Let’s not forget the social experience and personal growth facilitated by university life, which often lays the groundwork for future success.

In my opinion, while degrees provide a solid foundation, they are not the only route to achieving one's career goals. The emphasis should be on fostering skills and embracing lifelong learning, keeping an open mind to the various pathways that lead to success.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
"Muvaffaqiyat baxtning kaliti emas. Baxt muvaffaqiyatning kalitidir." Bu ko'pincha muvaffaqiyatli karera uchun universitet diplomlarining zarurligini muhokama qilganda aks sado beradi. Bir tomondan, Stiv Jobs va Mark Tsukerberg kabi ko'plab muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorlar akademik malakalar muvaffaqiyat zinapoyasidan ko'tarilish uchun zarur emasligini ko'rsatdilar. Coursera va Udemy kabi onlayn kurslar va platformalarning rivojlanishi o'z-o'zini boshqaruvchi ta'lim uchun ko'plab imkoniyatlarni ochdi. Ba'zi sohalarda, ayniqsa texnologiya sohasida, ko'nikmalar va innovatsiyalar rasmiy malakalardan ustun turadi, bu esa shaxslarga an'anaviy ravishda diplom egalari uchun ajratilgan rollarga kirishga imkon beradi.

Boshqa tomondan, diplomga ega bo'lish mavjud ish imkoniyatlari doirasini sezilarli darajada kengaytirishi, ko'pincha yuqori maoshlarga olib kelishi inkor etib bo'lmaydigan haqiqatdir. Tibbiyot va huquq kabi kasblar mavjudki, ularda rasmiy ta'lim mutlaq zaruratdir, bu standartlarga javob berilishini va saqlanishini ta'minlaydi. Bundan tashqari, universitet tajribasi o'z karera yo'lida hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan bebaho aloqa imkoniyatlarini taqdim etadi. Universitet hayoti tomonidan ta'minlangan ijtimoiy tajriba va shaxsiy o'sishni unutmaylik, bu ko'pincha kelajakdagi muvaffaqiyat uchun zamin yaratadi.

Mening fikrimcha, diplomlar mustahkam poydevor yaratgan holda, ular o'z karera maqsadlariga erishishning yagona yo'li emas. E'tibor ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirishga va umrbod ta'limni qabul qilishga qaratilishi kerak, muvaffaqiyatga olib boradigan turli yo'llarga ochiq fikrda bo'lish kerak.
